name: matched-flop-action-values-20261123
designated_hero: one rotating seat per independent deal, index modulo six
eligibility: first flop decision reached by the designated hero with at least two distinct legal choices; include agreement and disagreement; no outcome selection
primary_candidate: equal mixture of the four scheduled snapshots at the first hero flop decision
post_root_hero_policy: specialist480 for all actions after the forced choice
root_action_coverage: every distinct concrete legal action with positive mass in any of the five measured policies
hidden_cards: original twelve private cards and observed flop held fixed per deal; draw a fresh unseen turn and river without replacement per repetition
coupling: common sampled runout and action randomness keyed by deal, repetition, seat, street and within-seat/street decision across actions and opponent fields
response_unit: bb of terminal hero payoff per sampled first flop decision, using 100 chips per big blind
estimand: dot product of each root probability change and conditional action values with common frozen downstream hero; equal means over original deals and over the three fixed model seeds
primary_contrasts: public minus self480 on the matched mixture effect
tight-value minus self480 on the matched mixture effect
primary_intervals: paired original-deal cluster normal intervals, nominal and Bonferroni simultaneous 95 percent for the five contrasts
interpretation: a local action effect under 480-reached flops; comparisons across opponent fields change only downstream opponents on the same physical states
